title: Samay Cybersecurity Publications
summary: A coordinated set of cybersecurity publications translating dense technical material into clear, credible and brand-consistent print communication.
thumbnail_alt: Samay Infosolutions cybersecurity whitepaper cover presented on a navy background
outcome: A consistent publication system that helps technical information remain structured, readable and recognisably Samay across long- and short-form formats.

seo.title: Samay Cybersecurity Publication Design | Shubham Pendse
seo.description: Whitepaper, CISO checklist and brochure design for Samay Infosolutions, created as a consistent B2B cybersecurity publication system.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: Samay Infosolutions needed technical cybersecurity content to feel authoritative without becoming visually exhausting. Across a whitepaper, a practical CISO checklist and an aiSOC service brochure, I developed layouts that could handle long-form reading, structured checklists, diagrams, statistics and product information while maintaining one recognisable visual language.

sections.heading: Editorial direction
sections.body: The system was designed around clarity and trust rather than decorative complexity.

items.title: Technical content made scannable
items.body: Headings, callouts, diagrams and controlled column widths break dense cybersecurity material into clear reading paths.

items.title: One brand across three formats
items.body: The navy, cyan and white palette, angular graphic language and footer system remain consistent from the short brochure to the long-form whitepaper.

items.title: Designed for real documents
items.body: The layouts accommodate checklists, tables, questions, charts and narrative copy without losing hierarchy or page-to-page rhythm.
